pages.text: Ingots are refined metal materials used in crafting plates and other items. TechCraft adds several types of ingots:$(br)• Tin Ingot$(br)• Steel Ingot$(br)• Bronze Ingot$(br)• Nickel Ingot$(br)• Silver Ingot$(br)• Prismite Ingot$(br)• Quantum Ingot

pages.title: Tin Ingot
pages.text: Obtained by smelting Raw Tin in a furnace or blast furnace.

pages.title: Steel Ingot
pages.text: A durable metal alloy used for advanced crafting. Can be crafted from Coal Dust and Iron Dust.

pages.title: Bronze Ingot
pages.text: An alloy of copper and tin, commonly used for basic electrical components.

pages.title: Nickel Ingot
pages.text: A corrosion-resistant metal used in advanced alloys and cables.

pages.title: Silver Ingot
pages.text: A conductive metal with magical properties, used in special crafting.

pages.title: Prismite Ingot
pages.text: A rare crystalline metal with unique refractive properties.

pages.title: Quantum Ingot
pages.text: An extremely advanced material with quantum properties, used in end-game technology.
